Comments (English): [ Highly recommended to anyone who wants to buy it ] || ---------------- || The reasons I held out on buying a dishwasher: 1. Because it didn't wash many dishes. 2. But I wonder why I bought it now. I thought about it for about a month and put it in my cart, but it dropped to the early 200,000 won range during a sale, so I bought it. You just mix the rudiments in water, and I liked that I could do other things in my spare time without being stressed. The electricity and water bills didn't increase much. It was super convenient because the technician installed it himself. Of course, I was a little anxious about having to wait for the technician to arrive, but that's to be expected since all home appliances are like that. Comments (English): [ Highly recommended to anyone who wants to buy it ] || ---------------- || Here are the reasons I held out on buying a dishwasher: 1. It didn't produce enough dishes. 2. It said it did a pre-wash, but I didn't know how that was different from washing dishes. 3. It didn't seem to take up much space. 4. I thought the electricity, water, and detergent bills would be high. 5. Dishwashers are expensive, so I figured that would compensate for the inconvenience. But I wonder why I bought it now. I considered it for about a month and put it in my cart. It was on sale, so I bought it when it dropped to the low 200,000 won range. The pre-wash was just a matter of stirring it in water. I liked the fact that I could do other things without stress. My electricity and water bills didn't increase much. On days when my bill was low, I just filled a bucket with water and let it sit, then ran it through once. Buying it during a fresh sale was great because it didn't cost much. Having the installer install it for me was incredibly convenient. Of course, having to wait for the installer to arrive was a bit unsettling, but that's how all appliances work, so I figured that was understandable. I felt like other brands that don't come with a technician cost extra because they require accessories (dishwasher installation screws, water purifier installation kit). This product doesn't have an automatic door opening or hot air drying, so I have to open it myself after washing, and it's a shame that there's no washing wing on top, but I like it because it's cheap and saves on electricity bills. I thought it would be small so I couldn't fit many things, but it did, even a 28cm fan and a cutting board. It was bigger than I thought, which was nice. I think I'll be able to fit more as my stacking skills improve.

Sentence (English): Once I load the dishes and start the wash, the wash time is significantly reduced, making it quick and efficient.
Comments (English): The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher is truly a satisfying product. From the moment I installed it and started using it, I was impressed by its performance. The design is undoubtedly luxurious and sophisticated. True to its name, the Objet Collection blends perfectly with my kitchen interior, creating a clean, modern feel. I particularly appreciate how the built-in design saves space, making the kitchen feel more spacious and organized. The dishwasher has a capacity for 14 people, making it ideal for large families. Even when multiple people are using it, it's incredibly efficient, washing a large load at once. I have family dinners several times a week, and I used to worry about washing dishes, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, that burden has been greatly reduced. Once I load the dishes and start the wash, the wash time is significantly reduced, making it quick and efficient. Furthermore, the clean, shiny dishes I see after the wash are incredibly satisfying. The dishwasher's excellent cleaning performance and minimal residue leave me satisfied. The high-pressure water jet system thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny of the dishes, even those heavily stained with grease or grime. Furthermore, various cleaning modes allow for customized cleaning based on the type and level of dirt on the dishes, making it incredibly convenient. The smart cleaning function scans the condition of the dishes being washed and automatically selects the appropriate cleaning course, making it even more convenient. The noise level was surprisingly low. Its quiet operation allowed me to do other tasks or chat in the kitchen without any inconvenience. Loud noise from a dishwasher can be a nuisance, but this unit was comfortable and easy to use. I was also very pleased with the fact that the dishwasher dries well after each wash, leaving it almost ready to use without the need for manual wiping. The intuitive front display allows you to check the wash status and remaining time at a glance. Easy setup made it easy for anyone to operate. The ability to remotely control the device via smartphone is also incredibly useful. Even when you're out and about, you can start and stop the wash from your smartphone, making time management more efficient. Installation was easy, and it was ready to use right away without any hassle, so I was very satisfied from start to finish. LG's after-sales service is also reliable, which is a huge plus. While the price is a bit high, I think it's well worth it. Overall, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Built-In Dishwasher is an excellent product in every way, including design, performance, convenience, and noise. Packed with features that significantly improve kitchen efficiency and consider user convenience, this dishwasher has become a valuable asset in the home. Its large capacity and efficient cleaning performance will satisfy even large families or those who cook frequently.

The design is undoubtedly luxurious and sophisticated. True to its name, the Objet Collection blends perfectly with my kitchen interior, creating a clean, modern feel. I particularly appreciate how the built-in design saves space, making the kitchen feel more spacious and organized. The dishwasher has a capacity for 14 people, making it ideal for large families. Even when multiple people are using it, it's incredibly efficient, washing a large load at once. I have family dinners several times a week, and I used to worry about washing dishes, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, that burden has been greatly reduced. Once I load the dishes and start the wash, the wash time is significantly reduced, making it quick and efficient. Furthermore, the clean, shiny dishes I see after the wash are incredibly satisfying. The dishwasher's excellent cleaning performance and minimal residue leave me satisfied. The high-pressure water jet system thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny of the dishes, even those heavily stained with grease or grime. Furthermore, various cleaning modes allow for customized cleaning based on the type and level of dirt on the dishes, making it incredibly convenient. The smart cleaning function scans the condition of the dishes being washed and automatically selects the appropriate cleaning course, making it even more convenient. The noise level was surprisingly low. Its quiet operation allowed me to do other tasks or chat in the kitchen without any inconvenience. Loud noise from a dishwasher can be a nuisance, but this unit was comfortable and easy to use. I was also very pleased with the fact that the dishwasher dries well after each wash, leaving it almost ready to use without the need for manual wiping. The intuitive front display allows you to check the wash status and remaining time at a glance. Easy setup made it easy for anyone to operate. The ability to remotely control the device via smartphone is also incredibly useful. Even when you're out and about, you can start and stop the wash from your smartphone, making time management more efficient. Installation was easy, and it was ready to use right away without any hassle, so I was very satisfied from start to finish. LG's after-sales service is also reliable, which is a huge plus. While the price is a bit high, I think it's well worth it. Overall, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Built-In Dishwasher is an excellent product in every way, including design, performance, convenience, and noise. Packed with features that significantly improve kitchen efficiency and consider user convenience, this dishwasher has become a valuable asset in the home. Its large capacity and efficient cleaning performance will satisfy even large families or those who cook frequently.
Comments (Original): LG전자 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기 14인용은 정말 만족스러운 제품입니다. 처음 설치하고 사용을 시작한 순간부터 그 성능에 감탄하게 되었습니다. 디자인은 말할 것도 없이 고급스럽고 세련되었습니다. 오브제컬렉션이라는 이름에 걸맞게 주방 인테리어와 완벽하게 어울리며, 깔끔하고 모던한 느낌을 줍니다. 특히, 빌트인 형태라 공간을 절약할 수 있어 주방이 더욱 넓고 정돈된 느낌을 주는 점이 매우 마음에 들었습니다.식기세척기의 용량은 14인용으로, 큰 가족이 있는 집에서도 충분히 사용하기 좋습니다. 여러 명이 사용할 경우에도 한 번에 많은 식기를 세척할 수 있어 매우 효율적입니다. 저는 일주일에 몇 번씩 가족들끼리 모여서 식사하는데, 그때마다 설거지가 걱정이었는데 이제는 이 식기세척기 덕분에 그 부담이 많이 줄어들었습니다. 식기들을 넣고 세척을 시작하면, 세척 시간이 예전에 비해 상당히 단축되어 빠르고 효율적으로 끝납니다. 게다가 세척 후에는 깨끗하고 윤기가 나는 식기를 볼 수 있어 정말 기분이 좋습니다.세척 성능이 뛰어나고, 세척 후 잔여물도 거의 남지 않아 만족도가 높습니다. 고압수 분사 시스템 덕분에 그릇의 구석구석까지 깨끗하게 세척되며, 특히 기름때나 찌든 때가 심한 그릇들도 깔끔하게 처리됩니다. 또한, 다양한 세척 모드가 제공되어 식기의 종류나 오염 정도에 따라 맞춤 세척이 가능해 매우 편리합니다. “스마트 세척” 기능을 사용하면 세척하려는 식기의 상태를 스캔해 적절한 세척 코스를 자동으로 선택해줘서 더욱 편리하게 사용할 수 있습니다.소음도 예상보다 매우 적었습니다. 조용하게 작동하여 주방에서 다른 일을 하거나 대화할 때 불편함을 느끼지 않았습니다. 식기세척기 사용 시 소음이 크면 생활에 방해가 될 수 있는데, 이 제품은 그런 걱정 없이 편안하게 사용할 수 있었습니다. 또한, 세척 후 건조도 잘 되어서 따로 손으로 닦을 필요 없이 거의 바로 사용할 수 있는 상태로 나온다는 점이 매우 만족스러웠습니다.전면 디스플레이는 직관적으로 구성되어 있어 세척 상태나 남은 시간 등을 한눈에 확인할 수 있어 편리합니다. 설정도 간편해서 누구나 쉽게 조작할 수 있었습니다. 스마트폰과 연결되어 원격으로 작동을 제어할 수 있다는 점도 굉장히 유용합니다. 외출 중에도 스마트폰으로 세척을 시작하거나 중지할 수 있어 시간 관리가 더욱 효율적입니다.설치도 간편하고, 설치 후에는 별다른 수고 없이 바로 사용할 수 있어서 처음부터 끝까지 매우 만족스러웠습니다. LG의 AS 서비스도 믿을 수 있어서 안심하고 사용할 수 있다는 점이 큰 장점입니다. 가격대가 조금 높긴 하지만, 그만큼의 가치가 충분히 있다고 생각됩니다.전체적으로 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기 14인용은 디자인, 성능, 편리함, 소음 등 모든 면에서 뛰어난 제품입니다. 주방의 효율성을 크게 높여주고, 사용자의 편의를 고려한 다양한 기능들이 가득한 이 식기세척기는 집안에서 큰 도움을 주는 존재가 되었습니다. 큰 용량과 효율적인 세척 성능 덕분에 대가족이나 자주 요리하는 집에서도 충분히 만족할 수 있을 것입니다.

Sentence (English): Installation was easy, and it was ready to use right away without any hassle, so I was very satisfied from start to finish.
Comments (English): The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher is truly a satisfying product. From the moment I installed it and started using it, I was impressed by its performance. The design is undoubtedly luxurious and sophisticated. True to its name, the Objet Collection blends perfectly with my kitchen interior, creating a clean, modern feel. I particularly appreciate how the built-in design saves space, making the kitchen feel more spacious and organized. The dishwasher has a capacity for 14 people, making it ideal for large families. Even when multiple people are using it, it's incredibly efficient, washing a large load at once. I have family dinners several times a week, and I used to worry about washing dishes, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, that burden has been greatly reduced. Once I load the dishes and start the wash, the wash time is significantly reduced, making it quick and efficient. Furthermore, the clean, shiny dishes I see after the wash are incredibly satisfying. The dishwasher's excellent cleaning performance and minimal residue leave me satisfied. The high-pressure water jet system thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny of the dishes, even those heavily stained with grease or grime. Furthermore, various cleaning modes allow for customized cleaning based on the type and level of dirt on the dishes, making it incredibly convenient. The smart cleaning function scans the condition of the dishes being washed and automatically selects the appropriate cleaning course, making it even more convenient. The noise level was surprisingly low. Its quiet operation allowed me to do other tasks or chat in the kitchen without any inconvenience. Loud noise from a dishwasher can be a nuisance, but this unit was comfortable and easy to use. I was also very pleased with the fact that the dishwasher dries well after each wash, leaving it almost ready to use without the need for manual wiping. The intuitive front display allows you to check the wash status and remaining time at a glance. Easy setup made it easy for anyone to operate. The ability to remotely control the device via smartphone is also incredibly useful. Even when you're out and about, you can start and stop the wash from your smartphone, making time management more efficient. Installation was easy, and it was ready to use right away without any hassle, so I was very satisfied from start to finish. LG's after-sales service is also reliable, which is a huge plus. While the price is a bit high, I think it's well worth it. Overall, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Built-In Dishwasher is an excellent product in every way, including design, performance, convenience, and noise. Packed with features that significantly improve kitchen efficiency and consider user convenience, this dishwasher has become a valuable asset in the home. Its large capacity and efficient cleaning performance will satisfy even large families or those who cook frequently.

The design is undoubtedly luxurious and sophisticated. True to its name, the Objet Collection blends perfectly with my kitchen interior, creating a clean, modern feel. I particularly appreciate how the built-in design saves space, making the kitchen feel more spacious and organized. The dishwasher has a capacity for 14 people, making it ideal for large families. Even when multiple people are using it, it's incredibly efficient, washing a large load at once. I have family dinners several times a week, and I used to worry about washing dishes, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, that burden has been greatly reduced. Furthermore, various cleaning modes allow for customized cleaning based on the type and level of dirt on the dishes, making it incredibly convenient. The smart cleaning function scans the condition of the dishes being washed and automatically selects the appropriate cleaning course, making it even more convenient. The noise level was surprisingly low. Its quiet operation allowed me to do other tasks or chat in the kitchen without any inconvenience. Loud noise from a dishwasher can be a nuisance, but this unit was comfortable and easy to use. I was also very pleased with the fact that the dishwasher dries well after each wash, leaving it almost ready to use without the need for manual wiping. The intuitive front display allows you to check the wash status and remaining time at a glance. Easy setup made it easy for anyone to operate. The ability to remotely control the device via smartphone is also incredibly useful. Even when you're out and about, you can start and stop the wash from your smartphone, making time management more efficient. Installation was easy, and it was ready to use right away without any hassle, so I was very satisfied from start to finish. LG's after-sales service is also reliable, which is a huge plus. While the price is a bit high, I think it's well worth it. Overall, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Built-In Dishwasher is an excellent product in every way, including design, performance, convenience, and noise. Packed with features that significantly improve kitchen efficiency and consider user convenience, this dishwasher has become a valuable asset in the home. Its large capacity and efficient cleaning performance will satisfy even large families or those who cook frequently.
Comments (Original): LG전자 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기 14인용은 정말 만족스러운 제품입니다. 처음 설치하고 사용을 시작한 순간부터 그 성능에 감탄하게 되었습니다. 디자인은 말할 것도 없이 고급스럽고 세련되었습니다. 오브제컬렉션이라는 이름에 걸맞게 주방 인테리어와 완벽하게 어울리며, 깔끔하고 모던한 느낌을 줍니다. 특히, 빌트인 형태라 공간을 절약할 수 있어 주방이 더욱 넓고 정돈된 느낌을 주는 점이 매우 마음에 들었습니다.식기세척기의 용량은 14인용으로, 큰 가족이 있는 집에서도 충분히 사용하기 좋습니다. 여러 명이 사용할 경우에도 한 번에 많은 식기를 세척할 수 있어 매우 효율적입니다. 저는 일주일에 몇 번씩 가족들끼리 모여서 식사하는데, 그때마다 설거지가 걱정이었는데 이제는 이 식기세척기 덕분에 그 부담이 많이 줄어들었습니다. 식기들을 넣고 세척을 시작하면, 세척 시간이 예전에 비해 상당히 단축되어 빠르고 효율적으로 끝납니다. 게다가 세척 후에는 깨끗하고 윤기가 나는 식기를 볼 수 있어 정말 기분이 좋습니다.세척 성능이 뛰어나고, 세척 후 잔여물도 거의 남지 않아 만족도가 높습니다. 고압수 분사 시스템 덕분에 그릇의 구석구석까지 깨끗하게 세척되며, 특히 기름때나 찌든 때가 심한 그릇들도 깔끔하게 처리됩니다. 또한, 다양한 세척 모드가 제공되어 식기의 종류나 오염 정도에 따라 맞춤 세척이 가능해 매우 편리합니다. “스마트 세척” 기능을 사용하면 세척하려는 식기의 상태를 스캔해 적절한 세척 코스를 자동으로 선택해줘서 더욱 편리하게 사용할 수 있습니다.소음도 예상보다 매우 적었습니다. 조용하게 작동하여 주방에서 다른 일을 하거나 대화할 때 불편함을 느끼지 않았습니다. 식기세척기 사용 시 소음이 크면 생활에 방해가 될 수 있는데, 이 제품은 그런 걱정 없이 편안하게 사용할 수 있었습니다. 또한, 세척 후 건조도 잘 되어서 따로 손으로 닦을 필요 없이 거의 바로 사용할 수 있는 상태로 나온다는 점이 매우 만족스러웠습니다.전면 디스플레이는 직관적으로 구성되어 있어 세척 상태나 남은 시간 등을 한눈에 확인할 수 있어 편리합니다. 설정도 간편해서 누구나 쉽게 조작할 수 있었습니다. 스마트폰과 연결되어 원격으로 작동을 제어할 수 있다는 점도 굉장히 유용합니다. 외출 중에도 스마트폰으로 세척을 시작하거나 중지할 수 있어 시간 관리가 더욱 효율적입니다.설치도 간편하고, 설치 후에는 별다른 수고 없이 바로 사용할 수 있어서 처음부터 끝까지 매우 만족스러웠습니다. LG의 AS 서비스도 믿을 수 있어서 안심하고 사용할 수 있다는 점이 큰 장점입니다. 가격대가 조금 높긴 하지만, 그만큼의 가치가 충분히 있다고 생각됩니다.전체적으로 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기 14인용은 디자인, 성능, 편리함, 소음 등 모든 면에서 뛰어난 제품입니다. 주방의 효율성을 크게 높여주고, 사용자의 편의를 고려한 다양한 기능들이 가득한 이 식기세척기는 집안에서 큰 도움을 주는 존재가 되었습니다. 큰 용량과 효율적인 세척 성능 덕분에 대가족이나 자주 요리하는 집에서도 충분히 만족할 수 있을 것입니다.

Sentence (English): Its large capacity and efficient cleaning performance will satisfy even large families or those who cook frequently.
Comments (English): The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher is truly a satisfying product. From the moment I installed it and started using it, I was impressed by its performance. The design is undoubtedly luxurious and sophisticated. True to its name, the Objet Collection blends perfectly with my kitchen interior, creating a clean, modern feel. I particularly appreciate how the built-in design saves space, making the kitchen feel more spacious and organized. The dishwasher has a capacity for 14 people, making it ideal for large families. Even when multiple people are using it, it's incredibly efficient, washing a large load at once. I have family dinners several times a week, and I used to worry about washing dishes, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, that burden has been greatly reduced. Once I load the dishes and start the wash, the wash time is significantly reduced, making it quick and efficient. Furthermore, the clean, shiny dishes I see after the wash are incredibly satisfying. The dishwasher's excellent cleaning performance and minimal residue leave me satisfied. The high-pressure water jet system thoroughly cleans every nook and cranny of the dishes, even those heavily stained with grease or grime. Furthermore, various cleaning modes allow for customized cleaning based on the type and level of dirt on the dishes, making it incredibly convenient. The smart cleaning function scans the condition of the dishes being washed and automatically selects the appropriate cleaning course, making it even more convenient. The noise level was surprisingly low. Its quiet operation allowed me to do other tasks or chat in the kitchen without any inconvenience. Loud noise from a dishwasher can be a nuisance, but this unit was comfortable and easy to use. I was also very pleased with the fact that the dishwasher dries well after each wash, leaving it almost ready to use without the need for manual wiping. The intuitive front display allows you to check the wash status and remaining time at a glance. Easy setup made it easy for anyone to operate. The ability to remotely control the device via smartphone is also incredibly useful. Even when you're out and about, you can start and stop the wash from your smartphone, making time management more efficient. Installation was easy, and it was ready to use right away without any hassle, so I was very satisfied from start to finish. LG's after-sales service is also reliable, which is a huge plus. While the price is a bit high, I think it's well worth it. Overall, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Built-In Dishwasher is an excellent product in every way, including design, performance, convenience, and noise. Packed with features that significantly improve kitchen efficiency and consider user convenience, this dishwasher has become a valuable asset in the home. Its large capacity and efficient cleaning performance will satisfy even large families or those who cook frequently.

Comments (English): [ Excited to do dishes again! ] || ---------------- || For the life of me, I never thought I'd be this excited by a new appliance! Seriously, I actually look forward to using this dishwasher all the time after the one that came with the house (at least 10 years old) needed a solder repair to the control board that took out the heating element and eventually needed replacing due to a horrendous grinding noise and leak. Self-installation went very smoothly thanks to the clear instructions. Extremely quiet. The companion smart device app is pretty straight forward, especially with the ability to schedule it to run when electricity rates are lower, though I do not appreciate how the app is absolutely required for a delayed start. A simple 1/2/4/etc.-hr delay should be included in the control panel for those in the family who can't be bothered install the companion app on their smart phone. Hence the deduction of a star in my rating.

Sentence (English): All the other housework is really fine, but seriously.
Comments (English): All the other housework is really fine, but seriously. Washing the dishes is so so annoying. Even though I've been living alone for over 10 years. I can't get used to washing the dishes. I'd just let a week's worth of dishes pile up and do them all at once. Hehe. But after holding out and holding out, I finally bought a dishwasher! Coupang Installation was able to install it right away on the designated day. The installer drilled a small hole in the artificial marble countertop and connected the water pipe (he told me that he would apply silicone to the hole when moving) and did all the finishing touches. I bought new dishes and immediately washed them in the dishwasher. I also washed the fish plate and frying pan. They washed well. When I have a small amount of dishes, I use the fast mode. There is no fishy smell and it works well. I use the dishwasher detergent (tablet) from Naturepong. This is for 6 people, so I heard that you can use it without cutting it. I just throw it on the floor without putting it in the detergent container. It doesn’t slip and there is no fishy smell. It works well. It’s so convenient that it does the dishes for me. I wish I had bought it a long time ago. The dishwasher is right next to the faucet, so water splashes. I installed a water stopper on the dishwasher side. I feel comfortable and happy.

Sentence (English): I have had the Bosch 800 dishwasher for about three months.
Comments (English): [ THE BEST DISHWASHER. ] || ---------------- || I have had the Bosch 800 dishwasher for about three months. Delivery, install and haul away was as expected and very well done. It replaced a six year old Bosch dishwasher that developed leaks and and was not worth the cost to repair. For reference the vast majority of meals my family eats are prepared at home and we entertain frequently. The dishwasher is run at least twice a day. I went through two top of the line kitchen aid dishwashers that lasted about two years each. I switched to Bosch and have no plans to ever try other brands. It is a dependable workhorse. The dishes and cookware come out clean and dry. The crystal dry really works and I think it is worth paying for this feature. Our water is not hard enough to require use of the water softener. Cleaning the filter weekly takes about three minutes. Note that the back two rows of tines on the bottom rack fold down as does the right side row of tines on the middle rack. This makes it easier to load pans and bowls. The third rack increases the capacity of the dishwasher and I recommend it. We rarely use the app because the top of door controls are easier and faster. I considered the Bosch Benchmark that Costco also sells but I wanted the towel bar this model has and did not find the additional features (projected floor clock and interior light) to be worth the extra cost. This dependable dishwasher makes our lives easier and I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): Lots of things not disclosed about the operation of this product.
Comments (English): [ Heated dry can not be turned off. Unit feels cheap ] || ---------------- || Lots of things not disclosed about the operation of this product. There is no option to turn off heated dry. If you are low in rinse aid it automatically turns on extra dry. This might be fine if all you wash are glass, ceramic and metal. I have kids and lots of their stuff is plastic. I have had melted cups, deformed lids, and plastic stuff shrink, even on the top rack. All of this stuff that has been ruined was washed for years in my whirlpool dishwasher, it had an option to turn of heated dry and it would run a fan all night until you open the washer in the morning. It worked well for us and I just assumed that all dishwashers would have this option. I did check this lg and it does have the fan. Just no option to turn off heated dry. Maybe it is hidden in a multi button push but nothing that was printed in the directions. The actual dishwasher feels cheap. The top is plastic and the bottom of the door is most definitely not stainless steel. It deflects in with the slightest push of your finger. Our old washer was stainless. Had a solid feel. In fact you could slam into it flat handed, and it would not bend. I never tried to actually bend it but it was perfectly smooth after 10 years. Top rack is not adjustable height wise. There is an extra set of wheels on the side so maybe there was a way to assemble it lower. Nothing in the directions about this. Again my old washer had a low and high setting. With the LG, the top rack is several inches above the plates yet bowls will not fit on the top rack without hitting the third rack. Lots of features missing. Overall capacity is way lower for our use and we are now handwashing all the kids stuff (what's left of it).

Sentence (English): For over 10 years of my marriage, I used to do dishes by hand, but lately I really hated the chore and felt like such a waste of time.
Comments (English): For over 10 years of my marriage, I used to do dishes by hand, but lately I really hated the chore and felt like such a waste of time. However, because our house is small, I hadn't even considered getting a dishwasher. I had my eye on this model because I happened to hear that its slim design made it suitable for small homes, and I finally bought it at a great price during a sale. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I feel almost cheated for not getting one sooner. I debated between white and ivory, but I chose ivory. It isn't a yellowish ivory; it is a light, clean shade that I really like. The installation was also hassle-free; the technician contacted me in advance and did a great job, so there were no issues. They say bigger is better when it comes to dishwashers, but for a family of three, it is sufficient for running a cycle after just one meal. It feels like the dishes are even cleaner than when washed by hand. I wouldn't say it is completely silent, but in my opinion, it wasn't loud enough to be a major concern. Once it finishes, the door automatically opens to release heat and the dishes dry slowly, so I think it is fine even without a hot air drying function. Of course, it is difficult to fit large cooking utensils like pots and pans in, so I quickly hand-wash those. I actually hated washing small items like plates, cups, and spoons even more, so I am extremely satisfied just with how this handles them. It feels so good to be able to enjoy a cup of tea after a meal and relax, instead of standing in front of the sink and struggling to wash dishes. I don't think I can go back to life without a dishwasher. I highly recommend it to anyone considering buying one.

I think I'll get the hang of it after using it a couple more times and use it well. Thanks for the service, Auntie Media!

Sentence (English): The dishwasher cleans well and is SUPER quiet, but there are some features that I am having a hard time getting used to.
Comments (English): The dishwasher cleans well and is SUPER quiet, but there are some features that I am having a hard time getting used to. The racks feel a little shaky when I pull them in and out. The touch control on the front panel doesn't work that well; it takes several attempts when I press ON. Then when I press START, it is so quiet that I truly can't tell if it has started. When it finishes, it dings and the CLEAN light comes on, but it only stays on for a short time, so if my husband started the machine, I'm not sure what the status is. I'm having a hard time getting used to the different way I have to put dishes in compared to my previous KitchenAid, and it doesn't seem to hold as much, but the jury is still out on that. There seem to be larger openings where small items could fall through. The silverware baskets are not as deep as the KitchenAid, so some things fall out, and it's a little tricky putting the baskets (there are 2) back in after putting away silverware.

Sentence (English): Ordered this as a replacement after my previous mid-tier GE had a pump part failure for the 4th time in 5 yrs.
Comments (English): [ Worth the cost? Questionable. ] || ---------------- || Ordered this as a replacement after my previous mid-tier GE had a pump part failure for the 4th time in 5 yrs. Right off the bat the Bosch has unquestionably better fit, finish, QC, etc. Its hard to describe, but I could just feel an immediate quality difference between the two. That said, we have been using the Bosch for a month now and there are definitely issues. 1) It cleans as well as our old GE, maybe slightly better. but for almost double the cost I'd expect the Bosch to be better. 2) It really struggles with drying. The manual recommends adding rinse aid. Their app lets you also select a high intensity dry, but even when set to that and on extended length dry and with rinse aid, nothing ever truly gets dry. Thanks to this, it is likely that when it is necessary to replace a washing machine or dryer in the future, the first choice will be Bosch again.

You can purchase the product that's right for you there for a little under 30,000 won. The installation process is not difficult. Just plug it into the middle of the sink hose as shown in the second picture. If you have a hose before installing the dishwasher, the technicians can install it for you. However, FMs don't do it. The technician I met also said that you have to do the non-hitch installation yourself. And the white line on the sink hose may be unsightly, but I'm so satisfied with being able to use the dishwasher that I can ignore it all. It really changes my quality of life. The width from the front to the back is really big. For the first time, I put in the dishes that I used to make kimchi fried rice. After the washing is finished, there is a lot of water inside, but if you leave the door open and wait about 2 hours, it will dry cleanly, so you can close the door then. I'm really happy that my stress has decreased since installing the dishwasher. Late purchase You will only regret it. Since it is easy to install, you should definitely buy a dishwasher! I bought it in my late 30s with credit card benefits. I hope you put it in your shopping cart and wait until it goes on sale before buying it.

I'm really happy that my stress has decreased since installing the dishwasher. Late purchase You will only regret it. Since it is easy to install, you should definitely buy a dishwasher! I bought it in my late 30s with credit card benefits. I hope you put it in your shopping cart and wait until it goes on sale before buying it.

Sentence (English): I love cooking and spend most of my time in the kitchen, especially cooking.
Comments (English): [ It doesn't have a dramatic effect, but ] || ---------------- || I love cooking and spend most of my time in the kitchen, especially cooking. I've been a full-time housewife for 9 years. My kitchen is small at 21 pyeong. Because of that, I'm very interested in kitchenware, but buying even one thing is a lot of trouble. It's not easy to find space for two, and if I buy too much, the kitchen seems like a war zone, so I spend days and days worrying and agonizing over buying something. I really love cooking, and I especially do my best to make dinner for my husband when he gets home from work, but because of that, the dishes pile up like a mountain. If I wash the dishes right after cooking, the pile is barely enough. In this reality, I put on a show of making a kitchen space by putting various dishwashers in my shopping cart and measuring the sizes. After about a month of that, I bought a dishwasher as a wedding present for my younger sister, and she said it was great. It's enough for 6 people and it washes well. I was tempted by those words, so I chose this Minix dishwasher. I ordered it with the thought that if it didn't come in my size, I'd return it right away, but this is the size for our small kitchen. I think it's perfect. The design is pretty. The box it came in is bigger and heavier than I thought. I installed it easily by myself. There's nothing difficult, but the picture of connecting the water pipe in the manual was a bit confusing, so I scanned the QR code and watched it, but I understood it right away after watching the video. It's a bit noisy. I fill the water tank with water and use it, but I have to fill the large cup that comes with it more than 4 times, which is a bit annoying. I'm still testing the performance by changing detergents, so I plan to revise the review later. It's not as dramatic as I expected, but it gives me more than 30 minutes of free time when I used to wash the dishes for an hour each evening, so I'm still very satisfied. I used to use two types of detergent, capsules and tablets, for about 10 days, and my conclusions are * I can't feel much difference in the detergent form * It's important to use the right detergent for the size ### (I used a mini detergent for 1-6 people) * The key is to stack the dishes neatly. I liked stacking them at a 45-degree angle! Now that I've gotten the hang of stacking, there are almost no water stains or detergent marks left on the bowls at first! When I wash them upside down, water collects in the concave grooves at the bottom of the bowls, but I set it to safe storage mode in the evening and when I wake up, the fan runs periodically to dry them. When I take them out in the morning and check, they're almost dry. I wipe them one more time with a dry dishcloth to finish them off. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the more I use it, the more I think it was a good purchase. Since it washes, dries, and sterilizes, it feels like someone is doing my homework for me. I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

Sentence (English): I've been a full-time housewife for 9 years.
Comments (English): [ It doesn't have a dramatic effect, but ] || ---------------- || I love cooking and spend most of my time in the kitchen, especially cooking. I've been a full-time housewife for 9 years. My kitchen is small at 21 pyeong. Because of that, I'm very interested in kitchenware, but buying even one thing is a lot of trouble. It's not easy to find space for two, and if I buy too much, the kitchen seems like a war zone, so I spend days and days worrying and agonizing over buying something. I really love cooking, and I especially do my best to make dinner for my husband when he gets home from work, but because of that, the dishes pile up like a mountain. If I wash the dishes right after cooking, the pile is barely enough. In this reality, I put on a show of making a kitchen space by putting various dishwashers in my shopping cart and measuring the sizes. After about a month of that, I bought a dishwasher as a wedding present for my younger sister, and she said it was great. It's enough for 6 people and it washes well. I was tempted by those words, so I chose this Minix dishwasher. I ordered it with the thought that if it didn't come in my size, I'd return it right away, but this is the size for our small kitchen. I think it's perfect. The design is pretty. The box it came in is bigger and heavier than I thought. I installed it easily by myself. There's nothing difficult, but the picture of connecting the water pipe in the manual was a bit confusing, so I scanned the QR code and watched it, but I understood it right away after watching the video. It's a bit noisy. I fill the water tank with water and use it, but I have to fill the large cup that comes with it more than 4 times, which is a bit annoying. I'm still testing the performance by changing detergents, so I plan to revise the review later. It's not as dramatic as I expected, but it gives me more than 30 minutes of free time when I used to wash the dishes for an hour each evening, so I'm still very satisfied. I used to use two types of detergent, capsules and tablets, for about 10 days, and my conclusions are * I can't feel much difference in the detergent form * It's important to use the right detergent for the size ### (I used a mini detergent for 1-6 people) * The key is to stack the dishes neatly. I liked stacking them at a 45-degree angle! Now that I've gotten the hang of stacking, there are almost no water stains or detergent marks left on the bowls at first! When I wash them upside down, water collects in the concave grooves at the bottom of the bowls, but I set it to safe storage mode in the evening and when I wake up, the fan runs periodically to dry them. When I take them out in the morning and check, they're almost dry. I wipe them one more time with a dry dishcloth to finish them off. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the more I use it, the more I think it was a good purchase. Since it washes, dries, and sterilizes, it feels like someone is doing my homework for me. I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

I've been a full-time housewife for 9 years. My kitchen is small at 21 pyeong. Because of that, I'm very interested in kitchenware, but buying even one thing is a lot of trouble. It's not easy to find space for two, and if I buy too much, the kitchen seems like a war zone, so I spend days and days worrying and agonizing over buying something. I really love cooking, and I especially do my best to make dinner for my husband when he gets home from work, but because of that, the dishes pile up like a mountain. If I wash the dishes right after cooking, the pile is barely enough. In this reality, I put on a show of making a kitchen space by putting various dishwashers in my shopping cart and measuring the sizes. After about a month of that, I bought a dishwasher as a wedding present for my younger sister, and she said it was great. It's enough for 6 people and it washes well. I was tempted by those words, so I chose this Minix dishwasher. I ordered it with the thought that if it didn't come in my size, I'd return it right away, but this is the size for our small kitchen. I think it's perfect. The design is pretty. The box it came in is bigger and heavier than I thought. I installed it easily by myself. There's nothing difficult, but the picture of connecting the water pipe in the manual was a bit confusing, so I scanned the QR code and watched it, but I understood it right away after watching the video. It's a bit noisy. I fill the water tank with water and use it, but I have to fill the large cup that comes with it more than 4 times, which is a bit annoying. I'm still testing the performance by changing detergents, so I plan to revise the review later. It's not as dramatic as I expected, but it gives me more than 30 minutes of free time when I used to wash the dishes for an hour each evening, so I'm still very satisfied. I used to use two types of detergent, capsules and tablets, for about 10 days, and my conclusions are * I can't feel much difference in the detergent form * It's important to use the right detergent for the size ### (I used a mini detergent for 1-6 people) * The key is to stack the dishes neatly. I liked stacking them at a 45-degree angle! Now that I've gotten the hang of stacking, there are almost no water stains or detergent marks left on the bowls at first! When I wash them upside down, water collects in the concave grooves at the bottom of the bowls, but I set it to safe storage mode in the evening and when I wake up, the fan runs periodically to dry them. When I take them out in the morning and check, they're almost dry. I wipe them one more time with a dry dishcloth to finish them off. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the more I use it, the more I think it was a good purchase. Since it washes, dries, and sterilizes, it feels like someone is doing my homework for me. I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

It's not easy to find space for two, and if I buy too much, the kitchen seems like a war zone, so I spend days and days worrying and agonizing over buying something. I really love cooking, and I especially do my best to make dinner for my husband when he gets home from work, but because of that, the dishes pile up like a mountain. If I wash the dishes right after cooking, the pile is barely enough. In this reality, I put on a show of making a kitchen space by putting various dishwashers in my shopping cart and measuring the sizes. After about a month of that, I bought a dishwasher as a wedding present for my younger sister, and she said it was great. It's enough for 6 people and it washes well. I was tempted by those words, so I chose this Minix dishwasher. I ordered it with the thought that if it didn't come in my size, I'd return it right away, but this is the size for our small kitchen. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the more I use it, the more I think it was a good purchase. Since it washes, dries, and sterilizes, it feels like someone is doing my homework for me. I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

In this reality, I put on a show of making a kitchen space by putting various dishwashers in my shopping cart and measuring the sizes. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the more I use it, the more I think it was a good purchase. Since it washes, dries, and sterilizes, it feels like someone is doing my homework for me. I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

It's not easy to find space for two, and if I buy too much, the kitchen seems like a war zone, so I spend days and days worrying and agonizing over buying something. I really love cooking, and I especially do my best to make dinner for my husband when he gets home from work, but because of that, the dishes pile up like a mountain. If I wash the dishes right after cooking, the pile is barely enough. In this reality, I put on a show of making a kitchen space by putting various dishwashers in my shopping cart and measuring the sizes. After about a month of that, I bought a dishwasher as a wedding present for my younger sister, and she said it was great. It's enough for 6 people and it washes well. I was tempted by those words, so I chose this Minix dishwasher. I ordered it with the thought that if it didn't come in my size, I'd return it right away, but this is the size for our small kitchen. It's a bit noisy. I fill the water tank with water and use it, but I have to fill the large cup that comes with it more than 4 times, which is a bit annoying. I'm still testing the performance by changing detergents, so I plan to revise the review later. It's not as dramatic as I expected, but it gives me more than 30 minutes of free time when I used to wash the dishes for an hour each evening, so I'm still very satisfied. I used to use two types of detergent, capsules and tablets, for about 10 days, and my conclusions are * I can't feel much difference in the detergent form * It's important to use the right detergent for the size ### (I used a mini detergent for 1-6 people) * The key is to stack the dishes neatly. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the more I use it, the more I think it was a good purchase. Since it washes, dries, and sterilizes, it feels like someone is doing my homework for me. I feel comfortable and very satisfied.

Sentence (English): I love it, love it, love it!
Comments (English): I love it, love it, love it! Actually, the evening dishes that get put off since the day are always my husband's responsibility. (He gets frustrated when I do the dishes. He washes them in a flash, but when I do them, I rinse very thoroughly and take a long time, so even my parents get frustrated.) My husband started bringing up the topic of a dishwasher lately. At first, I had my eye on a Minik* 3-person model for about a month and even clicked the order button. But when my husband said, "Shouldn't we buy a major brand so we can use it for a long time?", I canceled immediately. So, I decided on the Samsung Bespoke, which proudly boasts the #1 best-selling dishwasher! I searched on YouTube and was tempted by some confusing videos, but I still decided, "Samsung is Samsung!" and bought it. Also, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. The price dropped by a few tens of thousands of won right after I bought it; it’s a bit embarrassing, but I have no regrets about the purchase. First off, two technicians came and installed it kindly, quietly, and quickly from start to finish. They drill holes for free on artificial marble surfaces; I heard there is an extra charge for stone! I connected it through the base cabinet (through the baseboard, up to the base, and connected it somewhere), and it was done in no time. I purchased and used *Fr*sh detergent. I pre-washed the items with water before putting them in, but as you can see in the photo of the baby plates, they don't wash well if stacked too vertically like that. Since I'm a total beginner, I'm still trying out different Tetris layouts. So, I decided on the Samsung Bespoke, which proudly boasts the #1 best-selling dishwasher! I searched on YouTube and was tempted by some confusing videos, but I still decided, "Samsung is Samsung!" and bought it. Also, the bigger the dishwasher, the better. The price dropped by a few tens of thousands of won right after I bought it; it’s a bit embarrassing, but I have no regrets about the purchase. First off, two technicians came and installed it kindly, quietly, and quickly from start to finish. They drill holes for free on artificial marble surfaces; I heard there is an extra charge for stone! I connected it through the base cabinet (through the baseboard, up to the base, and connected it somewhere), and it was done in no time. I purchased and used *Fr*sh detergent. I pre-washed the items with water before putting them in, but as you can see in the photo of the baby plates, they don't wash well if stacked too vertically like that. Since I'm a total beginner, I'm still trying out different Tetris layouts. The best part is this: I used to really run out of time doing housework, preparing side dishes, and washing everything while my child was at daycare, but now I have time left over! Also, I no longer have to be stingy with my utensils and dishes when cooking. The amount of dishes to wash in the evening has decreased, and the dishwasher lady takes care of the rest! I highly recommend it. ++After using it for two weeks, it is so convenient. We thought we used a lot of dishes, but we rinse the dishwasher-safe ones and put them in the dishwasher, sometimes running it just once in the evening. I think our dishes will gradually switch to just the safe ones. The amount of hand washing has decreased drastically, making things so much easier.

At first, I had my eye on a Minik* 3-person model for about a month and even clicked the order button. But when my husband said, "Shouldn't we buy a major brand so we can use it for a long time?", I canceled immediately. They drill holes for free on artificial marble surfaces; I heard there is an extra charge for stone! I connected it through the base cabinet (through the baseboard, up to the base, and connected it somewhere), and it was done in no time. I purchased and used *Fr*sh detergent. I pre-washed the items with water before putting them in, but as you can see in the photo of the baby plates, they don't wash well if stacked too vertically like that. Since I'm a total beginner, I'm still trying out different Tetris layouts. The best part is this: I used to really run out of time doing housework, preparing side dishes, and washing everything while my child was at daycare, but now I have time left over! Also, I no longer have to be stingy with my utensils and dishes when cooking. The amount of dishes to wash in the evening has decreased, and the dishwasher lady takes care of the rest! I highly recommend it. ++After using it for two weeks, it is so convenient. We thought we used a lot of dishes, but we rinse the dishwasher-safe ones and put them in the dishwasher, sometimes running it just once in the evening. I think our dishes will gradually switch to just the safe ones. The amount of hand washing has decreased drastically, making things so much easier.

Sentence (English): This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money.
Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.
Comments (Original): [ 4인 가족 이하에 적당한 가성비 좋은 식기세척기 ] || ---------------- || 내돈내산 솔직 후기입니다.안녕하세요 저는 결혼 9년차 직장인입니다.식기세척기 필요성을 별로 못 느껴서 안쓰고 있다가 올해 2월에 이사를 오게 되면서 식기세척기를 구매하게 되었습니다.지인이 해당 제품을 쓰고 있는데 너무 만족하게 쓰고 있다고 해서 저도 구매하게 되었는데요.2월에 구매해서 약 7개월 정도 사용한 리얼한 후기 들려 드릴게요.먼저 외관은 생각보다 큽니다.주방 싱크대 옆에 놓았는데 자리를 꽤나 차지하고 묵직한 느낌을 줍니다.주방이 좁은 집은 공간이 좀 좁을 수 있겠다는 생각을 했습니다.다행히 저희는 싱크대 옆에 식기세척기, 정수기를 배치하니 공간이 기가 막히게 맞아 떨어지더라고요 ㅎㅎ요즘 신혼 필수 가전 중의 하나인 식기세척기인데요. 결론부터 말하면 아주 요긴하게 잘쓰고 있습니다.사실 맞벌이 부부에게 제일 귀찮은게 저녁에 퇴근하고 와서 차려서 먹고 나면 피곤하고 설거지하기 정말정말 귀찮은데요 ㅜㅜ다들 공감하실거라고 생각합니다 ㅎㅎㅎ그래서 사실 그러면 안되지만 너무 귀찮아서 그다음날 아침에 일어나서 출근하기 전에 부랴부랴 하고 가기도 하는데요.사실 저는 성격이 바로바로 하는 스타일인데 아내는 그렇지 않습니다(????) ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ그래서 이번에 식기세척기를 구매하게 되었고 저녁 설거지에서 저와 아내를 해방시키는데 주 목적이 있었습니다.사용방법은 정말 간단합니다.그냥 내용물을 차곡차곡 안겹치게 넣고 고체로 된 세제하나 톡하고 집어 넣고 문을 닫고 전원 버튼 누르고 삼각형 버튼을 살짝 누르면 끝이랍니다.보통 표준모드로 1시간 27분 정도 소요되더라고요.뭐 급속, 강력모드는 여러가지 기능이 있지만 사실 한번도 사용한 적이 없다는....저녁먹고 나서 물로 대충대충 행궈서 넣고 세제 하나 넣고 시작만 하면 끝입니다.주의할 점을 그릇 등을 넣을때 아래 방향으로 넣어야 해요위아래에서 물이 다 나와서 컵 같은걸 바로 넣으면 다 끝나고 나서 물이 한가득 들어가있는 걸 발견하실 수 있을 겁니다 ㅋㅋㅋ작동이 다 되고 나면 뚜껑이 자동으로 열려서 좋습니다.내부의 열기와 습기를 잘 빠지게 하여 그릇들이 잘 마를 수 있게 해줍니다.막 끝낸 그릇을 꺼내어 보면 정말 뜨겁습니다.엄청난 고온으로 살균하듯이 깨끗하게 씻기는게 느껴질 정도로 만족스럽습니다.기름기 있던 그릇도 정말 기름기 하나 없이 깨끗하게 씻긴걸 보면 정말 사람이 설거지 한거 보다 백배 나은거 같아요 진심 ㅋㅋ성능하나는 정말 끝내주는거 같습니다.한 예로 커피를 자주마셔 내부가 살짝 변색된 애정하는 컵이 있었는데일반 주방세제로는 아무리 닦아내어도 잘 안되더라고요하지만 식기세척기를 사용하니 정말 새 것처럼 바뀌어서 놀랐던 기억이 있습니다.결론적으로 엄청 만족하고 삻의 질을 올려주는 저희 집에 없어서는 안될 소중한 가전제품이 되었습니다.식기세척기 구매를 고민하고 계신 분이라면 강력 추천 드립니다^^

Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.
