Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher suitable for families of four or fewer ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Hello, I am an office worker in my 9th year of marriage. I didn't feel the need for a dishwasher, so I hadn't been using one until I moved in February of this year, at which point I decided to purchase one. An acquaintance was using this product and said they were very satisfied with it, so I decided to buy one as well. I will share a real review based on about 7 months of use since purchasing it in February. First, the exterior is larger than I expected. I placed it next to the kitchen sink, and it takes up quite a bit of space and feels substantial. I thought that the space might feel a bit cramped for homes with small kitchens. Fortunately, when we placed the dishwasher and water purifier next to the sink, the space fit perfectly. The dishwasher is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days. To start with the conclusion, I am using it very effectively. Honestly, for dual-income couples, the most annoying thing is coming home from work in the evening, preparing a meal, and then having to do the dishes—since you are tired—which is just a really, really bothersome task. I think everyone can relate to this. So, even though we shouldn't, it is so bothersome that we sometimes wake up the next morning and rush to do the dishes before leaving for work. Actually, I’m the type to get things done immediately, but my wife isn’t like that (?). So, we decided to buy a dishwasher this time, with the main purpose being to free my wife and me from the evening dishwashing. Using it is really simple. You just pack the items neatly without overlapping, tap in a solid detergent packet, close the door, press the power button, and lightly press the triangle button—that’s it. It usually takes about 1 hour and 27 minutes on standard mode. While there are various functions like rapid and powerful modes, I’ve actually never used them. After dinner, I just rinse the dishes roughly with water, put them in, add a packet of detergent, and start it—that’s it. One thing to note is that you must load the dishes downwards. Since water comes out from both the top and bottom, if you put things like cups in directly, you’ll find the tank full of water when it finishes. It’s nice that the lid opens automatically once the cycle is complete. This allows the heat and moisture inside to escape effectively, helping the dishes dry properly. When you take out the dishes right after they finish, they are really hot. I am satisfied to the point where you can feel them being cleaned so thoroughly, almost as if they were being sterilized at an incredibly high temperature. Seeing how even greasy dishes are washed spotlessly clean without a single trace of grease, I honestly think it is a hundred times better than washing them by hand. The performance is truly outstanding. For example, I had a favorite cup that had become slightly discolored on the inside from frequent coffee. No matter how much I scrubbed it with regular dish soap, it wouldn't come off. However, after using the dishwasher, I remember being amazed at how it looked brand new. In conclusion, I am extremely satisfied, and it has become a precious appliance that is indispensable to my home, significantly improving my quality of life. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): Keep an eye on the install dudes.
Comments (English): [ Bad Install Service ] || ---------------- || Keep an eye on the install dudes. They unpacked inside the truck and rolled in my new dishwasher without the insulation blanket. I have purchased many dishwashers in my life and they all have had one. When I asked the delivery/install guy where it was he informed (lied to) me they don't come with one any longer. I should have went and looked inside the truck. So they installed it as is. The next day I called Whirlpool and they confirmed it does in fact come with the part and they will send me out one. Next I noticed it was installed crooked under the counter. When I pointed it out the guy just ignored me. It seemed like they were in a hurry to get to their next delivery. This model with the towel bar handle has the top controls. I could not see the controls on the left side. My son corrected that. The next day I washed a load of dishes. I looked under the cabinet to check for leaks. There were drips so I got under there with my flashlight and noticed a loose hose hanging down in the back off of the Air Gap. All of the dishwasher hoses were not connected. In CA we have an Air Gap connection code. They put the new air gap on my sink that came with the required kit but did not connect the air dap hose to the disposal. They just connected the dishwasher directly to the disposal instead of the air gap. They did not inform me of this. If the dispossink backs up the dirty water will go back into the dishwasher. I will have re install the dishwasher correctly when the missing part arrives. The dishwasher was quiet without the insulation blanket but will be quieter when it has one. The dishes were very clean but there was a little drying issue. Leaving the door ajar seemed to help. Next time I will try the EXTENDED HEAT DRY. I went back and forth about spending several hundred dollars more for a Bosch but this model got good reviews and I liked the third rack on the KA to hold all of my baking utensils. So I figured I would save some money. My appliances only seem to last 5 or 6 years no matter what brand I buy, right after the extended warranty runs out! I don't purchase those any more either. Home Depot did refund me my $126 install fee.

I am very satisfied with my new Bosch dishwasher and agree with the great reviews on-line.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher doesn't excellent job of cleaning well.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well dries poorly ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher doesn't excellent job of cleaning well. All of the whole cycle does take 3 hours. The one thing I am disappointed at is the lack of reasonable drying. We did not use the heating element in our 1993 dishwasher but the dishes were dryer at the end of a cycle then this dishwasher. The door doesn't pop open while the dishes are warm so water just sits on them. I like the idea of the door popping open instead of using the small vent that are old one had however due to the door not opening while the dishes are still warm water just sits on them until you open it up and pull them out and shake it off. It's a bit annoying, I would have probably chosen another dishwasher had I known this issue. On a side note because of a lack of vent, The dishwasher is a sealed compartment, it always smells when you start loading the dishwasher. We never had any stink in our old dishwasher but this one stinks after you put the first dirty dish in it. The door handle is also a little flimsy feeling. We got it on sale and even at that the price doesn't match the quality. The one thing I will say is it does clean better than our old one, for that I am thankful.

Sentence (English): The BOSCH 800 Series Dishwasher is a major appliance worthy of a price beyond that which is typical of more 'entry level' appliances.
Comments (English): [ Almost Perfect ] || ---------------- || The BOSCH 800 Series Dishwasher is a major appliance worthy of a price beyond that which is typical of more 'entry level' appliances. In short, it does an amazing job of both washing and drying dishes and other cookware without having to pre-rinse them. The system of 3 racks is an added plus. Additionally, and perhaps even more importantly, the adjustability / flexibility of each rack enable the user to load more cookware and to load it in a manner that maximizes its cleaning efficiency and effectiveness. This flexibility in how the dishwasher is loaded is also greatly enhanced by the fact that there is no heating element beneath the lowest rack. Concerns about damaging an item by loading it too close to that element are simply gone. While this 800 series Bosch model is, indeed, very quiet, the light that is shone on the floor while the cycle is still in progress is particularly helpful when the drying process, which is completely silent, is underway. Not a problem for us, but something to know in case that's a concern. Overall it's a powerful, yet quiet, workhorse and we're very happy with it. The Maytag brand is known for being long-lasting and never having breakdowns/problems, so that's what really drove us toward this model/brand. Our previous GE machine lasted seven years -- we're hoping this one lasts longer.

Sentence (English): This Bosch replaced an 11 year old Kitchenaid.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 ] || ---------------- || This Bosch replaced an 11 year old Kitchenaid. We chose it based on reviews of it's reliability and quiet performance. It was a little pricier than other models, but we felt it was worth it. After about 2 months we are reasonably happy with the dishwasher. It looks great and is exceptionally quiet. It cleans well. The third rack takes some getting used to, as do the other racks. The slots on the bottom rack are narrow and our dishes didn't fit, which was a problem. We actually had to replace them. The middle rack is adjustable and safely accommodates wine glasses. Also, the drying system is not the typical heating element so dishwasher safe plastic items don't melt. Overall, although it's taken some time to get accustomed to it, we are satisfied with this appliance.

Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet as a Mouse, Great Machine ] || ---------------- || This is our second Bosch dishwasher. It is super quiet, which is a major factor for us. It has plenty of room for dishes, utensils, pots, and pans after a full dinner for 5-6 adults. About the only thing it does not clean thoroughly is certain dried-on or residue from very "sticky" residue, such as might be left behind in a pot that has sat for a while after cooking rice. That said, such things are probably not suited for a normal dishwasher cycle, so I don't blame the model itself - that's just the reality of automatic dishwashers. We're still getting used to the utensil tray vs. the older-fashioned basket we've had throughout the years with several other machines, but it certainly works. There, too, sticky and/or dried on residue is a challenge, but again, that's one of those "by hand" items anyway. Overall, we're very pleased.

Sentence (English): This is so cheaply made.
Comments (English): [ Brand new and could fall apart ] || ---------------- || This is so cheaply made. Everything is held together by thin loose fitting plastic. Trays do not slide easily even when empty because everything is loosely held together by thin plastic. To be honest thinking about adding zip ties to prevent the thing from falling apart. The stainless steel is grey plastic. The handle flexes the whole front of machine just opening the dishwasher. Very disappointing. It cleans about as good as my 20 year old dishwasher just before is sadly stopped working, it dries the same nothing special, plastic is still wet. It is a little quieter. My old one was not at all quite but the difference is not as much as you would expect. I suspect most people could not tell the differences between 43db and 50 if not heard immediately after each other. The third rack is a joke. It is hard to pull/push in and out. And they give you only a tiny cutlery basket,. It is about 1/3 the size of a normal one so you are forced to fight with the 3rd rack. By using 3rd rack you can't fit a platter in bottom rack and a 16 oz cup in 2nd rack. Poorly designed. Wish I had my old noisy dishwasher that racks slid smoothly and flexible loading options. Forgot about putting a water bottle in unless you remove a rack. If the racks are so cheap who knows how cheap the rest of the machine is. If you don't have thin standard shape dishes it will be hard to impossible to load. The prongs are very close together and it can only be adjusted in a few areas. Wish I had spent several hundred dollars to fix old dishwasher. This is not worth 1350. I bought expensive Bosch because of reputation for reliability, but it's clear this will not be reliable. Looked at replacement parts because can't see poorly fitted plastic lasting especially with any weight and they want 30 for a plastic clip. Part that is actually worth less than one dollar. Bosch does not have any confidence in the product either when registering product they ask if you want to by insurance that product will last 4 years for more than $300. So they are either taking advantage of people or expect significant amount of repairs in 4 years or less.

Comments (English): [ Home appliances are LG! ] || ---------------- || LG has a strong image when it comes to home appliances, so of course it's LG. Before purchasing, I went to an appliance store to see it in person and compared it with other products before purchasing. First of all, the advantages! 1. It can hold a ton of food (it's a two-tier configuration, so it's perfect for a three-person household that uses more small ceramic dishes than large ones) 2. It's easy to use (the buttons are intuitive, it's easy to install with rocket installation, and it doesn't require a separate drain hole, which is nice) 3. The inside is all stainless steel, which is great (I think this is the only All-Stainless product). Moreover, it's made in Korea! 4. No water stains at all (When I used a 12-person unit at my previous home, I felt uncomfortable using it because of water stains, but this is a whole new world. There is really zero water stains.) 5. You can place it toward the sink, so you can put dishes right in (As you can see, I put the door toward the sink, so I put the dishes right in the dishwasher while dripping water! It's super convenient.) My husband really praises this idea. 6. It's so easy to take out the filter and easy to clean (The 12-person unit I used before had a cumbersome structure to take out the filter, but this one is a real deal.) 7. It uses little water. 8. After eating meat, I put in the air fryer and turned it on, and it transformed into three products. 9. It's UV, so I sent carrots to the baby bottle sterilizer. No need to worry about the automatic door not opening! (I tried it and if you dry it with hot air, it will be almost completely dry when you open it later, so there is no need to worry at all. If you are not going to leave it for several days, it was okay to close it for a day or so!) Disadvantages 1. It takes up a bit of space (but the advantages are overwhelming, so I don't care at all) 2. It takes some time (this is inevitable due to the nature of the dishwasher) 3. You have to drill holes when installing it (they are two very small holes. I didn't worry too much, but if it doesn't work at home, I think it might be a problem to worry about) This is an honest review that I bought with my own money. I always praise this to people around me and my mother-in-law, saying that it was a really good purchase. Thank you, my husband, for giving it to me as a gift.

It can hold a ton of food (it's a two-tier configuration, so it's perfect for a three-person household that uses more small ceramic dishes than large ones) 2. It's easy to use (the buttons are intuitive, it's easy to install with rocket installation, and it doesn't require a separate drain hole, which is nice) 3. The inside is all stainless steel, which is great (I think this is the only All-Stainless product). Moreover, it's made in Korea! 4. No water stains at all (When I used a 12-person unit at my previous home, I felt uncomfortable using it because of water stains, but this is a whole new world. There is really zero water stains.) 5. You can place it toward the sink, so you can put dishes right in (As you can see, I put the door toward the sink, so I put the dishes right in the dishwasher while dripping water! It's super convenient.) My husband really praises this idea. 6. It's so easy to take out the filter and easy to clean (The 12-person unit I used before had a cumbersome structure to take out the filter, but this one is a real deal.) 7. It uses little water. 8. After eating meat, I put in the air fryer and turned it on, and it transformed into three products. 9. It's UV, so I sent carrots to the baby bottle sterilizer. No need to worry about the automatic door not opening! (I tried it and if you dry it with hot air, it will be almost completely dry when you open it later, so there is no need to worry at all. If you are not going to leave it for several days, it was okay to close it for a day or so!) Disadvantages 1. It takes up a bit of space (but the advantages are overwhelming, so I don't care at all) 2. It takes some time (this is inevitable due to the nature of the dishwasher) 3. You have to drill holes when installing it (they are two very small holes. I didn't worry too much, but if it doesn't work at home, I think it might be a problem to worry about) This is an honest review that I bought with my own money. I always praise this to people around me and my mother-in-law, saying that it was a really good purchase. Thank you, my husband, for giving it to me as a gift.

Now that installation is possible, the water flows well, which is great! I didn't want any holes drilled, so I was worried if it would fit in the hole where the water purifier line is. However, after seeing a review from someone who said they installed it by fitting it right in the water purifier's hole, I decided to buy it immediately! The installer said that as long as the hole is big enough to fit a hot Americano straw, it can be installed! The installer was incredibly kind and explained the functions in detail! We are a family of three—my husband, me, and our baby—and since we don't produce as many dishes as I expected, we are using the small 6-place setting dishwasher very well! Since my child still drinks milk in a straw cup, I use the bottle sterilization function a lot! Above all, the white color matches our home perfectly! Because it was installed right next to the water purifier, it was difficult to use the induction cooktop, so I have now moved the dishwasher's location after moving the water purifier! I am using it so well that I am completely satisfied! I purchased a model without a hot air drying function, but since the door opens automatically after it finishes and the dishes are placed directly on the drying rack for natural drying, it isn't inconvenient at all! I am using it so well that I am completely satisfied! After moving, I was considering buying a large dishwasher, but I thought I wouldn't use a big one often, so I decided to purchase the 6-place setting model! Before moving, I used a 6-place setting dishwasher from a different brand, but since it was a drill-free model that required filling the water tank, I always had a hard time filling it every time I ran the dishwasher. I am using it so well that I am completely satisfied! After moving, I was considering buying a large dishwasher, but I thought I wouldn't use a big one often, so I decided to purchase the 6-place setting model! Before moving, I used a 6-place setting dishwasher from a different brand, but since it was a drill-free model that required filling the water tank, I always had a hard time filling it every time I ran the dishwasher. Now that installation is possible, the water flows well, which is great! I didn't want any holes drilled, so I was worried if it would fit in the hole where the water purifier line is. We are a family of three—my husband, me, and our baby—and since we don't produce as many dishes as I expected, we are using the small 6-place setting dishwasher very well! Since my child still drinks milk in a straw cup, I use the bottle sterilization function a lot! Above all, the white color matches our home perfectly! Because it was installed right next to the water purifier, it was difficult to use the induction cooktop, so I have now moved the dishwasher's location after moving the water purifier! I am using it so well that I am completely satisfied! I purchased a model without a hot air drying function, but since the door opens automatically after it finishes and the dishes are placed directly on the drying rack for natural drying, it isn't inconvenient at all! I am using it so well that I am completely satisfied! After moving, I was considering buying a large dishwasher, but I thought I wouldn't use a big one often, so I decided to purchase the 6-place setting model! Before moving, I used a 6-place setting dishwasher from a different brand, but since it was a drill-free model that required filling the water tank, I always had a hard time filling it every time I ran the dishwasher. Now that installation is possible, the water flows well, which is great! I didn't want any holes drilled, so I was worried if it would fit in the hole where the water purifier line is. However, after seeing a review from someone who said they installed it by fitting it right in the water purifier's hole, I decided to buy it immediately! The installer said that as long as the hole is big enough to fit a hot Americano straw, it can be installed! The installer was incredibly kind and explained the functions in detail! We are a family of three—my husband, me, and our baby—and since we don't produce as many dishes as I expected, we are using the small 6-place setting dishwasher very well! Since my child still drinks milk in a straw cup, I use the bottle sterilization function a lot! Above all, the white color matches our home perfectly! I am using it so well that I am completely satisfied! Sentence (English): How LG Electronics is mocking consumers.
Comments (English): [ How LG Electronics is fooling consumers. ] || ---------------- || How LG Electronics is mocking consumers. I checked the 15cm wooden mop holder before installation and checked everything until the installation technician visited. Installation took about 30 minutes and in the final test stage, I confirmed that the door was stuck on the mop holder and would not open 100%! The technician said that I had to call a professional to cut 2.5cm. I looked into various companies and they said that I had to pay more than 100,000 won. Feeling frustrated, I checked the website and was shocked and angry to see that cutting the wooden mop holder was included in the free service items. I couldn't understand why they are mocking consumers like this. They said the mop holder is 15cm, so I can't understand why they are asking me to cut more! The customer service representative just said sorry mechanically and I will wait and see when this will be resolved. I really hope they take it away!

Sentence (English): Don't buy this appliance from Whirlpool.
Comments (English): [ Unit was defective. Customer service from Home Depot and whirlpool was the worst part!  ] || ---------------- || Don't buy this appliance from Whirlpool. Don't buy from Home Depot. My old dishwasher got broken on Feb 24, on the same date I purchased online from HD this unit, it arrived on Thursday 27 of February. On Friday my technician could not come to install it. He came on Monday March 3 and after installing it he told me that the dishwasher is defective. The pump doesn't pull water. Today, Tuesday 4th of March I called Home Depot. Customer service said it is more than 48 hrs since the delivery so you have to call Whirlpool. I did, and Whirlpool told me that the first date available for a technician to come is on March 12. I told them, i can't wait for so many days. They told me to try to call back Home Depot. I did and this time I asked to speak with a manager. She repeated that I am out of the 48 hrs window and they cannot do anything for me. I told her: I received the unit in Thursday, I got it installed on Monday and now I have to wait up to the 12th? She said, yes. This is no customer service. I was able to install it on the following 2nd business day and I have to wait 8 days to get a new unit repaired. This is unbelievably frustrating, and the worst is that I didn't know about the 48 hours limit. You had to read it kn the email telling you that the product is in its way and that gives you the tracking number among other information. The info about the 48 hrs to call for a problem was at the very end of the email. Why providing customers with a so small period of time, only 48 hours to call for a problem? Probably because in this way they can just say that it is not their business anymore. Too bad Home Depot. Signed by: A previous loyal customer of Home Depot who has purchased multiple appliances in the past several years. :((

Sentence (English): We recently had to replace our old dishwasher which had served us well for 15 years.
Comments (English): [ What a difference NEW Technology makes!  ] || ---------------- || We recently had to replace our old dishwasher which had served us well for 15 years. I won't mention the brand because I really have nothing but good things to say for it. As a matter of fact, we would have likely bought the same brand as the old one, but we were informed that the maker had deleted the leak protection backup system in the new units, which meant that if your dishwasher began to leak, you would likely never know unless your cabinetry started rotting from water damage or water began leaking out into your kitchen while you thought all was as good as always. Based on that we began to shop for a replacement. We had heard good reviews about the Bosch brand and after some shopping and comparisons, we decided on the Bosch.
